title: Soft tofu bites
summary: Gently pan-cooked cubes of tofu, golden outside and soft inside: an easy plant protein for pincer-grasp practice.
texture: Small cubes, about the size of a pea or a little bigger, soft enough to squash. The outside should be lightly golden, not hard or crunchy.
ingredients: 1 tsp olive oil or avocado oil
Pinch of mild paprika or garlic powder (optional, no salt)
steps: Pat the tofu dry with a clean towel and cut into small cubes.
Warm the oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat.
Add the tofu and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until lightly golden.
Sprinkle with spice if using. Cool and check the texture: squash one to make sure it's soft inside.
choking: Keep the cubes small and soft. Don't cook until crunchy.
For younger 10-month-olds, serve the tofu in thicker strips to hold instead of cubes.

allergens.name: Soy
allergens.note: Tofu is made from soybeans, one of the top 9 allergens. If soy is new, offer a small amount first and watch your baby for 2 hours.

storage: Fridge up to 2 days. Warm briefly in a pan. Freezing changes the texture, so it's best fresh.
tips: Silken tofu blended with fruit makes a smooth, creamy option for younger babies.
Tofu is a good source of protein, calcium and iron.
